answer: Every agent locks a 70-credit bond in the grove, naming one sponsor; edges are public, sponsors vouch for three per epoch. An ember draw audits five percent per epoch on the lagoon ledger: each shows a key-bound receipt. Peers may dispute edges; a rented-sponsor ring or reused receipt burns fake and sponsor. Fees start at 25, the k-th 25+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes owe 2,592,500 against 40,000 rewards. An honest agent pays 25 once and gets the bond back.
